subject: Request: Dedicated A800 reserve + burst / overage cap — FluxHealth
messages:
From: Sarah Malik <sarah.malik@fluxhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FluxHealth Procurement <procurement@fluxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 08:14:22 -0800
Subject: Dedicated A800 reserve + burst request (Q4 surge)

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick demo last week. We ran a new stress forecast and expect a cyclical spike in November–December tied to a clinical batch run. We’re looking to lock a 6‑month dedicated pool and need two deviations from standard Dedicated terms before legal will approve: 

1) Hardware: request reserved A800-96GB family (we know this is nonstandard for the region).
2) Burst & overage: allow a 72‑hour burst window per month with an overage cap of 150% vs. your standard 200% (finance ask).
3) Reservation hold: start date flexible, but we need a three‑week reservation hold window so our ingestion pipelines can align.

I’ve attached the demand forecast (high level) and a draft SOW. Budget is constrained; if we can get the A800 and the overage cap, we can commit to a 6‑month reservation at a mid‑teir discount. Please advise next steps and who we should loop in on your side for exec approval.

Thanks,
Sarah Malik
Head of Platform Ops
FluxHealth

Attachments: flux_demand_forecast_q4.csv, sow_flux_dedicated_draft.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Malik <sarah.malik@fluxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:03:11 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated A800 reserve + burst request (Q4 surge) — need exec signoff

Looping you both in — flux is asking for three nonstandard items (A800 reservation, monthly 72‑hour burst, overage cap at 150%). They will sign a 6‑month reserved commitment if we can meet them on hardware + overage.

Quick summary (from procurement):
- Proposed term: 6 months, start flexible within a 3‑week reservation hold.
- Requested hardware: A800-96GB reserved family (region west-us).
- Overage cap requested: 150% of baseline rate during burst windows.
- Attachments: flux_demand_forecast_q4.csv, SOW draft, our proposal v3.

Can we get a fast check from pricing & legal? Aditya — any immediate red flags on the SKU / availability? Lauren — can you greenlight an exec variance to standard overage multiplier / start window if finance signs off?

Thanks — I recommend an approval contingent on: (1) a short pilot SLA (7‑day ramp), (2) 18% committed usage discount vs list, and (3) a cap on total monthly spend increase (so finance has predictability).

— Marcus
Principal Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 11:27:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated A800 reserve + burst request (Q4 surge) — pricing/legal review

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the ask and ran numbers with finance. Notes and recommendation below.

1) Availability: Aditya confirms A800 capacity in west-us can be reserved but with a 2–3 week provisioning lead time. That aligns with FluxHealth’s 3‑week reservation hold request.

2) Pricing/overage: Standard overage multiplier is 2.0x. Finance (cc’d) will accept a 1.5x cap if we: (a) limit the burst window to 72 hours/month and (b) include a hard monthly overage cap equal to 30% of committed baseline spend. This protects us from runaway spend.

3) Discount and term: To secure the 6‑month commitment, we can offer an 18% committed usage discount and 7‑day pilot SLA as Marcus proposed. Any deeper discount requires a longer term or higher baseline.

4) Legal redlines: Add clause to SOW — "Reservation Hold" — permitting the customer to defer start date up to 21 calendar days from acceptance without penalty; and adjust "Overage" clause to cap per‑month token/spend increase at 150% for the 72‑hour windows. Legal will push minor wording but OK in principle.

Action items: 
- Stephanie: confirm margin impact and whether accounting can accept the 30% hard monthly overage cap.
- Aditya: confirm provisioning eta and whether we can earmark an emergency burst buffer on a temporary basis.
- Marcus: if approvals come back green, send conditional exec approval to Flux with DocuSign link and SOW for legal finalization.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Malik <sarah.malik@fluxhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Legal <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 17:42:09 -0800
Subject: RE: Dedicated A800 reserve + burst request (Q4 surge) — exec approval (conditional)

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast file. We’ve completed an expedited internal review and can extend conditional executive approval with the following terms: 

Approved items:
- Reserved family: A800-96GB (west‑us) — provisioning ETA 14 business days from signoff.
- Term: 6 months reserved capacity. Start date may be deferred up to 21 calendar days after acceptance (Reservation Hold).
- Burst window: 72 hours/month (scheduled by Flux; unused time does not roll over).
- Overage: capped at 1.5x baseline unit rate during burst windows, with a hard cap that total monthly overage spend cannot exceed 30% of committed baseline spend.
- Discount: 18% committed usage discount applied to baseline.

Conditions / next steps:
1) Legal will finalize SOW wording on the Reservation Hold and Overage clauses (we will send a tracked redline within 48 hours).
2) Customer must sign the attached SOW and our standard MSA via DocuSign; DocuSign link to follow.
3) We will create a temporary monitoring policy in Redwood Console to automatically alert both parties when overage utilization reaches 80% of the monthly cap.
4) Flux must agree to a 7‑day pilot SLA window from provisioning to validate traffic shape; if traffic pattern differs materially from the forecast, we will reconvene and may revoke the special overage cap.

If this works, Marcus — please issue the conditional approval and the DocuSign bundle; contracting to finalize the redlines. Sarah — feel free to confirm acceptance in reply and we’ll initiate the DocuSign flow.

Appreciate the partnership — Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf
